meaning.en: to give the main points of something in a short and clear way

sentences.en: Summarize the story in three sentences.
sentences.zh: 用三句话概括这个故事。

sentences.en: Students should learn to summarize research findings accurately rather than reproduce every detail from their sources.
sentences.zh: 学生应学会准确概括研究结果，而不是复述资料中的每个细节。

meaning.en: a short account giving the main points of something

sentences.en: Please write a short summary of the article.
sentences.zh: 请为这篇文章写一个简短的摘要。

sentences.en: A clear summary at the beginning of a report helps readers understand its main findings quickly.
sentences.zh: 报告开头清晰的概要有助于读者迅速了解主要研究结果。

meaning.en: the warmest season of the year, between spring and autumn

sentences.en: We swim a lot in summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天我们经常游泳。

sentences.en: Rising summer temperatures may increase demand for electricity as more households rely on air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 夏季气温上升可能使更多家庭依赖空调，从而增加电力需求。

meaning.en: the highest point of a mountain

sentences.en: They reached the summit after a long climb.
sentences.zh: 经过长时间的攀登，他们到达了山顶。

sentences.en: The climbers struggled through heavy snow before finally standing on the summit.
sentences.zh: 登山者们在暴雪中艰难前行，最终站上了顶峰。

meaning.en: a meeting between leaders of governments or organizations

sentences.en: World leaders will meet at the climate summit next week.
sentences.zh: 世界各国领导人将于下周在气候峰会上会晤。

sentences.en: At the climate summit, national leaders discussed practical measures to reduce emissions and support vulnerable communities.
sentences.zh: 在气候峰会上，各国领导人讨论了减少排放和支持脆弱社区的实际措施。

meaning.en: to order someone to come, especially to a court or official meeting

sentences.en: The court will summon the witness.
sentences.zh: 法庭将传唤证人。

sentences.en: Governments must summon the political will to address environmental problems despite opposition from powerful industries.
sentences.zh: 尽管遭到强势行业的反对，政府仍须拿出解决环境问题的政治决心。

meaning.en: the star in the sky that gives the earth light and heat

sentences.en: The sun is shining brightly today.
sentences.zh: 今天太阳明亮地照耀着。

sentences.en: Energy from the sun can provide a renewable alternative to fossil fuels in regions with suitable conditions.
sentences.zh: 在条件适宜的地区，太阳能可以成为化石燃料的可再生替代能源。

meaning.en: A cream or lotion that protects the skin from sunlight.

sentences.en: Put some sunblock on your shoulders before swimming.
sentences.zh: 游泳前在肩膀上涂些防晒霜。

sentences.en: Using sunblock alongside protective clothing can reduce skin damage during prolonged exposure to sunlight.
sentences.zh: 长时间暴露在阳光下时，涂抹防晒霜并穿戴防护衣物可以减少皮肤损伤。

meaning.en: sore, red skin caused by too much time in the sun

sentences.en: Her sunburn hurt after the beach trip.
sentences.zh: 海滩旅行后，她的晒伤很疼。

sentences.en: Public health campaigns should explain that preventing sunburn requires suitable clothing and shade as well as sunscreen.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生宣传应说明，预防晒伤不仅需要防晒霜，还需要合适的衣物和遮阴。

meaning.en: made darker or sore by too much sun

sentences.en: His shoulders were sunburnt after a day at the beach.
sentences.zh: 在海滩待了一天后，他的肩膀晒伤了。

sentences.en: She came back from the holiday with a sunburnt nose and peeling skin.
sentences.zh: 她度假回来时鼻子晒伤了，皮肤还在脱皮。

meaning.en: A cream that protects the skin from the sun.

sentences.en: I packed suncream and a hat for our afternoon walk.
sentences.zh: 我为下午的散步带好了防晒霜和帽子。

sentences.en: Schools can encourage children to use suncream and seek shade during outdoor activities in sunny weather.
sentences.zh: 学校可以鼓励孩子们在晴天参加户外活动时涂防晒霜并注意遮阴。

meaning.en: the day of the week after Saturday and before Monday

sentences.en: We usually have a big lunch together on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我们通常在星期日一起做一顿丰盛的午餐。

sentences.en: Opening public libraries on Sunday allows people with busy weekday schedules to access essential community services.
sentences.zh: 公共图书馆星期日开放，让工作日忙碌的人也能享用重要的社区服务。

meaning.en: of various kinds; several and diverse

sentences.en: He packed sundry small tools.
sentences.zh: 他打包了各种各样的小工具。

sentences.en: The drawer was filled with sundry items such as old keys, buttons, and receipts.
sentences.zh: 抽屉里装满了各种杂七杂八的东西，比如旧钥匙、纽扣和收据。

meaning.en: a tall plant with a large yellow flower that turns to face the sun

sentences.en: The sunflower faces the sun.
sentences.zh: 向日葵朝着太阳。

sentences.en: A field of sunflowers stretched as far as we could see.
sentences.zh: 一片向日葵田一直延伸到我们目力所及之处。

meaning.en: dark glasses that protect your eyes from the sun

sentences.en: Wear sunglasses on a sunny day.
sentences.zh: 晴天要戴太阳镜。

sentences.en: Wearing sunglasses with adequate ultraviolet protection can reduce the risk of eye damage during outdoor activities.
sentences.zh: 在户外活动时，佩戴具有充分紫外线防护功能的太阳镜可以降低眼睛受损的风险。

meaning.en: the natural light that comes from the sun

sentences.en: Warm sunlight came through the window and fell on my desk.
sentences.zh: 温暖的阳光透过窗户洒在我的书桌上。

sentences.en: Designing classrooms to receive more natural sunlight may improve students' comfort and reduce electricity use.
sentences.zh: 让教室获得更多自然光的设计可能提高学生的舒适度，并减少用电。

meaning.en: with a lot of sunshine; bright and clear

sentences.en: Students study the word sunny in this book.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，我们在阳光充足的阳台上吃了早餐。

meaning.en: the time in the morning when the sun starts to rise in the sky

sentences.en: We woke early to watch the sunrise.
sentences.zh: 我们早早醒来观看日出。

sentences.en: Outdoor activities scheduled around sunrise allow tourists to enjoy cooler temperatures and observe local wildlife.
sentences.zh: 安排在日出前后的户外活动让游客能在较凉爽的气温下观赏当地野生动物。

meaning.en: a substance, usually a cream or lotion, that protects the skin from the sun

sentences.en: Put on sunscreen before you swim.
sentences.zh: 游泳前请先涂好防晒霜。

sentences.en: Using sunscreen alongside protective clothing can reduce skin damage caused by prolonged exposure to sunlight.
sentences.zh: 使用防晒霜并穿着防护衣物，可以减少长时间日晒造成的皮肤损伤。

meaning.en: the time when the sun goes down and night begins

sentences.en: We watched the sunset by the sea.
sentences.zh: 我们在海边看日落。

sentences.en: Coastal destinations often attract tourists with spectacular sunset views, creating valuable opportunities for local businesses.
sentences.zh: 沿海目的地常以壮丽的落日景色吸引游客，为当地企业创造宝贵商机。

meaning.en: a device, such as a parasol or awning, used to block sunlight and provide shade

sentences.en: We opened the sunshade above our garden table.
sentences.zh: 我们撑开了花园桌子上方的遮阳伞。

sentences.en: Installing a sunshade over each outdoor seating area can make public spaces more comfortable in summer.
sentences.zh: 在每处户外座椅区上方安装遮阳设施，可以让公共空间在夏季更加舒适。

meaning.en: light and warmth from the sun

sentences.en: We play outside in the sunshine.
sentences.zh: 我们在外面的阳光下玩耍。

sentences.en: Access to parks and sunshine can improve residents' wellbeing, especially in densely populated urban areas.
sentences.zh: 能够享用公园和阳光可以改善居民的身心健康，在人口密集的城市地区尤其如此。

meaning.en: extremely good; excellent

sentences.en: We had a super day outside.
sentences.zh: 我们在户外度过了非常愉快的一天。

sentences.en: Although users may describe an app as super helpful, researchers need objective evidence to assess its educational value.
sentences.zh: 尽管用户可能形容某款应用特别有帮助，研究人员仍需客观证据来评估其教育价值。

meaning.en: Extremely good in quality or performance.

sentences.en: The food at the restaurant was superb.
sentences.zh: 这家餐厅的食物非常棒。

sentences.en: The museum offers superb educational facilities, allowing visitors of all ages to explore scientific ideas through practical activities.
sentences.zh: 这家博物馆提供一流的教育设施，让各年龄段的参观者通过实践活动探索科学概念。

meaning.en: not deep or serious; only on the surface

sentences.en: That is a superficial view.
sentences.zh: 那是一种肤浅的看法。

sentences.en: His knowledge of the subject is superficial.
sentences.zh: 他对这个主题的了解很肤浅。

meaning.en: more than is needed or wanted; unnecessary

sentences.en: Those extra words are superfluous.
sentences.zh: 那些多余的话是多余的。

sentences.en: The report was criticized for containing superfluous details that obscured the main findings.
sentences.zh: 这份报告因包含大量多余细节、掩盖了主要发现而受到批评。

meaning.en: To oversee and take responsibility for work or an activity.

sentences.en: An experienced gardener superintended the planting of our trees.
sentences.zh: 一位经验丰富的园丁监督了我们种树的过程。

sentences.en: Qualified engineers should superintend major construction projects to ensure that safety standards are consistently maintained.
sentences.zh: 大型建设项目应由合格工程师监督，以确保始终遵守安全标准。

meaning.zh: 主管；监督人；（大楼的）管理员
meaning.en: a person who manages or supervises a place, activity, or group of workers

sentences.en: The superintendent checked the new building.
sentences.zh: 主管检查了那栋新楼。

sentences.en: The school superintendent announced a new policy for all teachers.
sentences.zh: 学区教育主管宣布了一项面向所有教师的新政策。

meaning.en: better in quality or value than others of the same kind

sentences.en: This tool is superior to the old one.
sentences.zh: 这个工具比旧的那个更好。

sentences.en: Public transport can provide a superior alternative to private cars when services are frequent and reliable.
sentences.zh: 当班次密集且服务可靠时，公共交通可以成为比私家车更好的出行选择。

meaning.en: The state of being better or stronger than something else.

sentences.en: The newer camera showed its superiority in low light.
sentences.zh: 这台较新的相机在弱光下展现了优势。

sentences.en: The technological superiority of larger firms can make it difficult for small businesses to compete effectively.
sentences.zh: 大公司的技术优势可能使小企业难以有效参与竞争。

meaning.zh: 超人（虚构的超级英雄）；超人般的人
meaning.en: a fictional superhero with extraordinary powers; an exceptionally strong or capable person

sentences.en: Superman is a famous superhero who can fly.
sentences.zh: 超人是著名的超级英雄，他会飞。

sentences.en: He worked like a superman to finish the project on time.
sentences.zh: 他像超人一样拼命工作，以按时完成项目。

meaning.en: a large shop that sells a wide range of food and household goods

sentences.en: We walk to the supermarket after school.
sentences.zh: 放学后我们步行去超市。

sentences.en: Large supermarkets can offer lower prices, but their expansion may threaten independent shops in smaller communities.
sentences.zh: 大型超市能提供更低的价格，但其扩张可能威胁小型社区里的独立商店。

meaning.en: not explained by the laws of nature; relating to forces beyond nature

sentences.en: The story is full of supernatural events.
sentences.zh: 这个故事充满了超自然事件。

sentences.en: Many cultures have stories about supernatural beings such as ghosts and spirits.
sentences.zh: 许多文化中都有关于鬼魂和神灵等超自然存在的故事。

meaning.en: To replace something older or no longer useful.

sentences.en: This new timetable supersedes the one on our fridge.
sentences.zh: 这份新时刻表取代了我们冰箱上的旧时刻表。

sentences.en: Digital payment systems may eventually supersede cash in many settings, although accessibility concerns must first be addressed.
sentences.zh: 数字支付系统最终可能在许多场景中取代现金，但必须先解决使用便利性方面的问题。

meaning.en: Travelling faster than sound, or involving such speeds.

sentences.en: We heard a loud boom as the supersonic aircraft passed.
sentences.zh: 超音速飞机飞过时，我们听到了一声巨响。

sentences.en: Supersonic passenger aircraft could shorten international journeys, but their noise and fuel consumption remain major concerns.
sentences.zh: 超音速客机可以缩短国际旅程，但其噪声和燃油消耗仍是主要问题。

meaning.en: a belief that is not based on reason or evidence, often involving luck or magic

sentences.en: That old superstition is not true.
sentences.zh: 那个古老的迷信说法不是真的。

sentences.en: Science education can help students distinguish evidence-based explanations from superstition while respecting different cultural traditions.
sentences.zh: 科学教育能帮助学生区分有证据支持的解释与迷信，同时尊重不同的文化传统。

meaning.en: believing that magic or luck controls events

sentences.en: He is superstitious about Friday.
sentences.zh: 他对星期五有迷信。

sentences.en: Superstitious beliefs may influence financial decisions when people rely on lucky objects rather than reliable evidence.
sentences.zh: 当人们依赖幸运物而非可靠证据时，迷信观念可能影响财务决策。

meaning.en: The part of a structure built above its base or deck.

sentences.en: Workers painted the ship's superstructure white before its departure.
sentences.zh: 工人在船出发前把船的上层结构漆成了白色。

sentences.en: Engineers must ensure that a building's foundations can safely support its entire superstructure under varying environmental conditions.
sentences.zh: 工程师必须确保建筑地基在不同环境条件下都能安全支撑整个上部结构。

meaning.en: to watch over and direct the work or activities of a person or group

sentences.en: Teachers supervise students during the test.
sentences.zh: 考试期间，老师监督学生。

sentences.en: Experienced nurses should supervise new staff to ensure that patients receive safe and effective care.
sentences.zh: 经验丰富的护士应指导新员工，确保患者获得安全有效的护理。

meaning.en: A person who oversees other people's work or activities.

sentences.en: My supervisor showed me how to use the equipment.
sentences.zh: 我的主管教我如何使用这些设备。

sentences.en: A supportive supervisor can help new employees develop confidence and adapt to unfamiliar workplace expectations.
sentences.zh: 支持员工的主管能帮助新员工建立信心，并适应不熟悉的工作要求。

meaning.en: a meal eaten in the evening

sentences.en: We eat supper at seven o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我们七点吃晚饭。

sentences.en: Sharing supper regularly can help families maintain close relationships despite increasingly demanding work schedules.
sentences.zh: 尽管工作安排日益繁忙，经常共进晚餐仍有助于家人维持亲密关系。

meaning.zh: 取代；替代（常指用新的或更有力的事物取代旧的）
meaning.en: to take the place of someone or something, especially in a forceful or gradual way

sentences.en: New tools supplant the old ones.
sentences.zh: 新工具取代了旧工具。

sentences.en: Over time, digital media have gradually supplanted traditional newspapers among younger readers.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，数字媒体在年轻读者中逐渐取代了传统报纸。

meaning.en: to add something to improve or complete another thing

sentences.en: You can supplement the meal with fresh fruit.
sentences.zh: 你可以用新鲜水果来补充这顿饭。

sentences.en: Many students supplement their classroom learning with online courses.
sentences.zh: 许多学生用在线课程来补充课堂学习。

meaning.en: something added to improve or complete something else, especially a pill or product added to the diet

sentences.en: This vitamin supplement is popular among athletes.
sentences.zh: 这种维生素补充剂在运动员中很受欢迎。

sentences.en: The book is a supplement to the main textbook.
sentences.zh: 这本书是主教材的补充读物。

meaning.en: a person or company that provides goods or services

sentences.en: Our bakery gets fresh flour from a local supplier.
sentences.zh: 我们面包店从一家本地供应商那里购买新鲜面粉。

sentences.en: Businesses should assess each supplier carefully to ensure that materials are produced under fair working conditions.
sentences.zh: 企业应仔细评估每一家供应商，确保原材料在公平的劳动条件下生产。

meaning.en: to provide something that is needed

sentences.en: Farms supply milk to the shops.
sentences.zh: 农场向商店供应牛奶。

sentences.en: Cities must secure a reliable water supply as population growth and climate change place increasing pressure on resources.
sentences.zh: 随着人口增长和气候变化给资源带来越来越大的压力，城市必须确保可靠的供水。

meaning.en: to help or encourage a person, team, or idea

sentences.en: We support our school football team.
sentences.zh: 我们支持学校的足球队。

sentences.en: Governments should provide financial support for small businesses that create jobs in economically disadvantaged communities.
sentences.zh: 政府应为在经济困难社区创造就业机会的小企业提供资金支持。

meaning.en: a person who supports a team, idea, political party, etc.

sentences.en: She is a strong supporter of the local football team.
sentences.zh: 她是当地足球队的坚定支持者。

sentences.en: The proposal gained supporters from both sides of the debate.
sentences.zh: 这项提议赢得了辩论双方的支持者。

meaning.zh: 给予支持（和帮助）的；支持的
meaning.en: giving help, encouragement, or understanding

sentences.en: My supportive sister helped me practise before the interview.
sentences.zh: 面试前，支持我的姐姐帮我做了练习。

sentences.en: A supportive classroom environment encourages students to ask questions without worrying about making mistakes.
sentences.zh: 充满支持的课堂环境能鼓励学生提问，而不必担心犯错。

meaning.en: to think that something is probably true

sentences.en: I suppose the bus is late again.
sentences.zh: 我想公交车又晚点了。

sentences.en: Suppose every household used less electricity; the combined reduction in demand could significantly benefit the environment.
sentences.zh: 假设每户家庭都减少用电，需求的总体下降就可能为环境带来显著益处。

meaning.en: according to what people say, though it may be untrue

sentences.en: This shortcut is supposedly quicker, but we keep getting lost.
sentences.zh: 据说这条近路更快，可我们一直迷路。

sentences.en: Some supposedly environmentally friendly products still require substantial energy to manufacture and transport to consumers.
sentences.zh: 一些号称环保的产品在生产和运送到消费者手中的过程中，仍需消耗大量能源。

meaning.en: used to introduce an imagined situation or possibility

sentences.en: Supposing the bus is late, can we walk instead?
sentences.zh: 假如公交车晚点，我们能改为步行吗？

sentences.en: Supposing that university education became free, how would governments cover the additional costs without reducing other essential services?
sentences.zh: 假如大学教育免费，政府如何在不削减其他基本服务的情况下承担额外费用？

meaning.en: an idea that is believed to be true without enough evidence

sentences.en: Your supposition about the missing keys turned out wrong.
sentences.zh: 你对钥匙丢失原因的猜测结果是错的。

sentences.en: Education policies should be based on reliable evidence rather than supposition about how children learn.
sentences.zh: 教育政策应以可靠证据为基础，而不是凭借对儿童学习方式的推测。

meaning.en: To stop a feeling, reaction, or action from being expressed or continuing.

sentences.en: I tried to suppress a sneeze during the concert.
sentences.zh: 音乐会期间，我努力忍住了一个喷嚏。

meaning.en: The act of forcibly preventing or restricting something, such as an activity, expression, or feeling.

sentences.en: The government's suppression of the protests drew international criticism.
sentences.zh: 政府对抗议活动的镇压招致了国际批评。

sentences.en: The suppression of public debate can weaken trust in institutions and prevent communities from addressing serious problems.
sentences.zh: 压制公共讨论会削弱人们对机构的信任，并妨碍社区解决严重问题。

meaning.en: the state of being more powerful or important than all others

sentences.en: The team kept its supremacy.
sentences.zh: 这支队伍保持了它的优势地位。

sentences.en: The empire struggled to maintain its military supremacy in the region.
sentences.zh: 该帝国努力维持其在该地区的军事霸权。

meaning.en: highest in rank or authority

sentences.en: The king held supreme power over the land.
sentences.zh: 国王对这片土地拥有最高权力。

sentences.en: In many countries, the supreme court can review whether new legislation complies with the constitution.
sentences.zh: 在许多国家，最高法院可以审查新法律是否符合宪法。

meaning.en: certain about something; having no doubt

sentences.en: I am sure this is right.
sentences.zh: 我确信这是对的。

sentences.en: Governments must make sure that rural communities have reliable access to essential healthcare services.
sentences.zh: 政府必须确保农村社区能够稳定地获得基本医疗服务。

meaning.en: Used to express strong belief or expectation that something is true or should happen

sentences.en: Surely you can spare five minutes to help?
sentences.zh: 你总能抽出五分钟来帮忙吧？

meaning.en: to spend time looking at different websites

sentences.en: I surf the internet after homework.
sentences.zh: 我做完作业后上网浏览。

sentences.en: Students who surf the internet for research need skills to distinguish reliable sources from misleading information.
sentences.zh: 上网查找研究资料的学生需要具备辨别可靠来源与误导性信息的能力。

meaning.en: the top or outside part of an object

sentences.en: The surface of the lake is still.
sentences.zh: 湖面很平静。

sentences.en: Dark road surfaces absorb heat during the day, contributing to higher temperatures in urban areas.
sentences.zh: 深色路面白天吸收热量，导致城市地区气温升高。

meaning.en: the sport of riding on waves while standing on a board

sentences.en: He loves surfing on big waves.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢在大浪上冲浪。

sentences.en: The growing popularity of surfing can support coastal economies while increasing pressure on fragile marine environments.
sentences.zh: 冲浪运动日益流行，既能促进沿海经济，也会加大脆弱海洋环境承受的压力。

meaning.en: a sudden strong increase or rise

sentences.en: There was a surge in prices.
sentences.zh: 价格出现了激增。

sentences.en: The company reported a surge in demand for its new electric cars.
sentences.zh: 该公司报告称，其新款电动汽车的需求激增。

meaning.en: a doctor who performs medical operations

sentences.en: The surgeon operated on his broken knee.
sentences.zh: 外科医生为他的膝盖骨折做了手术。

sentences.en: Rural hospitals often struggle to recruit experienced surgeons, which can delay essential treatment for local residents.
sentences.zh: 乡村医院往往难以招到经验丰富的外科医生，这可能导致当地居民无法及时获得必要治疗。

meaning.en: medical treatment in which a doctor cuts into a patient's body to repair or remove a part

sentences.en: She had surgery on her knee.
sentences.zh: 她接受了膝关节手术。

sentences.en: Advances in medical technology have made many types of surgery safer and reduced patients' recovery times.
sentences.zh: 医疗技术的进步提高了多种手术的安全性，并缩短了患者的康复时间。

meaning.en: relating to surgery or used in medical operations

sentences.en: He needs surgical care.
sentences.zh: 他需要外科护理。

sentences.en: The hospital has introduced a new surgical procedure to reduce recovery time.
sentences.zh: 这家医院引进了一种新的外科手术程序，以缩短康复时间。

meaning.en: to guess from incomplete information

sentences.en: I surmise that the train will be late.
sentences.zh: 我推测火车会晚点。

sentences.en: Researchers surmise that flexible schedules improve employee wellbeing, although stronger evidence is needed to confirm this.
sentences.zh: 研究人员推测弹性工作时间能改善员工身心状况，但仍需更有力的证据加以确认。

meaning.en: to successfully deal with or overcome a problem, difficulty, or obstacle

sentences.en: They surmount every difficulty.

meaning.en: a family name

sentences.en: My surname is often difficult for strangers to pronounce.
sentences.zh: 陌生人常常觉得我的姓很难念。

sentences.en: Naming traditions vary across cultures, and a person's surname may reflect family history or regional origins.
sentences.zh: 不同文化的命名传统各不相同，一个人的姓氏可能反映其家族历史或地域来源。

meaning.en: to be better or greater than

sentences.en: Her results surpass all earlier records.
sentences.zh: 她的成绩超过了以往所有记录。

sentences.en: Demand for renewable energy may surpass current forecasts as governments introduce stronger measures to reduce carbon emissions.
sentences.zh: 随着各国政府采取更有力的减碳措施，可再生能源需求可能超过目前的预测。

meaning.en: an amount that is more than what is needed or used

sentences.en: We have a surplus of rice.

meaning.en: more than is needed or used
something unexpected that happens, often pleasant

sentences.en: Mum plans a surprise for me.
sentences.zh: 妈妈为我准备了一个惊喜。

sentences.en: The survey results may surprise policymakers who assume that young people prefer online learning.
sentences.zh: 调查结果可能让那些认为年轻人偏爱线上学习的政策制定者感到意外。

meaning.en: to make someone feel surprised

sentences.en: The news surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 这个消息让所有人都感到惊讶。

meaning.en: Feeling that something unexpected has happened.

sentences.en: I was surprised to find flowers outside my door.
sentences.zh: 发现门外放着鲜花，我很惊讶。

sentences.en: Researchers were surprised by how strongly access to green spaces influenced residents' reported levels of wellbeing.
sentences.zh: 绿地的可及性对居民自报幸福感的影响如此之大，令研究人员感到惊讶。

meaning.zh: 令人惊讶的；出乎意料的
meaning.en: unexpected and causing a feeling of surprise

sentences.en: The tiny bakery offers a surprising variety of fresh bread.
sentences.zh: 这家小面包店的新鲜面包种类多得令人惊讶。

sentences.en: The survey revealed a surprising decline in car ownership among young adults living in major cities.
sentences.zh: 调查显示，大城市年轻人的汽车拥有率出现了出人意料的下降。

meaning.zh: 超现实的；离奇的，如梦般的
meaning.en: very strange and dreamlike, as if from a surrealist artwork

sentences.en: The scene felt surreal.
sentences.zh: 那个场景感觉如梦似幻。

sentences.en: Walking through the abandoned city at night was a surreal experience.
sentences.zh: 夜晚走过那座废弃的城市是一种超现实的体验。

meaning.en: to agree to stop fighting and to admit defeat

sentences.en: The army will surrender after the defeat.
sentences.zh: 战败后，军队将会投降。

sentences.en: Users should not have to surrender control of their personal information to access essential online services.
sentences.zh: 用户不应为了使用必要的在线服务而被迫放弃对个人信息的控制权。

meaning.en: a person or thing that takes the place of another

sentences.en: A surrogate will speak for the absent mayor.
sentences.zh: 一位代理人将为缺席的市长发言。

sentences.en: In some legal systems, a surrogate mother has limited parental rights.
sentences.zh: 在某些法律体系中，代孕母亲拥有的亲权有限。

meaning.en: to be all around someone or something

sentences.en: Tall trees surround the little house.
sentences.zh: 高大的树木环绕着小屋。

sentences.en: Uncertainty continues to surround the proposed transport scheme, making it difficult for local businesses to plan ahead.
sentences.zh: 拟议中的交通方案仍存在不确定性，使当地企业难以提前规划。

meaning.en: being all around someone or something

sentences.en: The surrounding countryside is very beautiful.
sentences.zh: 周围的乡村非常美丽。

sentences.en: The hotel is surrounded by surrounding hills, which makes the view especially peaceful.
sentences.zh: 这家酒店被周围的山丘环绕，景色格外宁静。

meaning.en: the things or conditions around a person or place

sentences.en: Children learn from their surroundings.
sentences.zh: 孩子们从周围环境中学习。

meaning.en: The places, objects, and conditions around a person or thing.

sentences.en: We ate lunch in the peaceful surroundings of the garden.
sentences.zh: 我们在花园宁静的环境中吃了午饭。

sentences.en: Students may concentrate better in pleasant surroundings, especially when classrooms offer natural light and views of greenery.
sentences.zh: 学生在舒适的环境中可能更容易集中注意力，尤其当教室采光自然且窗外有绿植时。

meaning.en: the careful watching of a person or place, especially by the police or army, because of a crime that may happen or has happened

sentences.en: Cameras provide surveillance of the shop.
sentences.zh: 摄像头对商店进行监控。

sentences.en: The police kept the suspect under constant surveillance.
sentences.zh: 警方对嫌疑人进行持续监视。

meaning.en: a set of questions used to find out people's opinions or experiences

sentences.en: The survey asks about our favourite food.
sentences.zh: 这项调查询问我们最喜欢的食物。

sentences.en: A recent survey suggests that many commuters would cycle more often if safer routes were available.
sentences.zh: 最近一项调查表明，如果有更安全的路线，许多通勤者会更经常骑自行车。

meaning.en: the state of remaining alive or continuing to exist

sentences.en: The lost hikers had blankets and other survival gear.
sentences.zh: 迷路的徒步者带着毯子和其他求生装备。

sentences.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for the survival of species threatened by climate change.
sentences.zh: 保护自然栖息地对于受气候变化威胁的物种生存至关重要。

meaning.en: to continue to live or exist, especially after a dangerous event or difficult period

sentences.en: Our little cactus survived three weeks without water.
sentences.zh: 我们的小仙人掌三个星期没浇水也活下来了。

sentences.en: Small businesses are more likely to survive economic downturns when they maintain strong relationships with local customers.
sentences.zh: 小企业若与本地顾客保持牢固联系，就更有可能挺过经济低迷期。

meaning.en: Someone who remains alive after danger, illness, or disaster.

sentences.en: Rescuers pulled a survivor from the flooded house.
sentences.zh: 救援人员从被淹的房屋中救出了一名幸存者。

sentences.en: Every disaster survivor should have access to safe housing, medical treatment, and long-term psychological support.
sentences.zh: 每位灾难幸存者都应能获得安全住所、医疗服务和长期心理支持。

meaning.en: easily affected, influenced, or harmed by something

sentences.en: Old people are susceptible to flu.
sentences.zh: 老年人容易患流感。

sentences.en: Children may be more susceptible to online advertising because they lack experience in evaluating commercial claims.
sentences.zh: 儿童可能更容易受到网络广告影响，因为他们缺乏评估商业宣传的经验。

meaning.en: a person believed to be guilty of a crime or of doing something wrong

sentences.en: Police questioned the suspect.
sentences.zh: 警方讯问了嫌疑人。

sentences.en: The suspect was released after the police found no evidence against him.
sentences.zh: 由于警方没有找到不利于他的证据，嫌疑人被释放了。

meaning.en: to believe that something is probably true or that someone is guilty, often without certain proof

sentences.en: I suspect the cat knocked the cup off the table.
sentences.zh: 我怀疑是猫把杯子从桌上碰掉了。

sentences.en: Researchers suspect that prolonged screen use may affect sleep quality, although further evidence is needed.
sentences.zh: 研究人员推测，长时间使用屏幕可能影响睡眠质量，不过仍需更多证据。

meaning.en: to stop something temporarily, or to delay it

sentences.en: Heavy rain will suspend the outdoor match.
sentences.zh: 大雨将使户外比赛暂停。

sentences.en: The airline suspended all flights because of the storm.
sentences.zh: 由于暴风雨，该航空公司暂停了所有航班。

meaning.zh: 令人紧张的；充满悬念的
meaning.en: causing a feeling of excitement or nervousness about what is going to happen

sentences.en: The suspenseful film kept us watching late into the night.
sentences.zh: 这部充满悬念的电影让我们一直看到深夜。

sentences.en: The novel builds a suspenseful atmosphere as the detective gets closer to the truth.
sentences.zh: 随着侦探越来越接近真相，这部小说营造出一种充满悬念的氛围。

meaning.en: A temporary stop to an activity or someone's participation

sentences.en: The student received a suspension for breaking the school rules.
sentences.zh: 这名学生因违反校规被停学。

sentences.en: The temporary suspension of construction work allowed researchers to assess the project's impact on local wildlife.
sentences.zh: 建筑工程的暂时停工让研究人员得以评估该项目对当地野生动物的影响。

meaning.en: a belief or feeling that someone has done something bad or that something is wrong

sentences.en: Police had a suspicion about the missing money.
sentences.zh: 警方对失踪的钱款有所怀疑。

sentences.en: A lack of transparency can increase public suspicion of how government contracts are awarded.
sentences.zh: 缺乏透明度会加深公众对政府合同授予方式的怀疑。

meaning.en: causing people to think something is wrong

sentences.en: A suspicious man waited near the shop.
sentences.zh: 一个可疑的男人在商店附近等候。

sentences.en: Consumers are increasingly suspicious of environmental claims that companies make without providing clear evidence to support them.
sentences.zh: 消费者越来越怀疑企业那些缺乏明确证据支持的环保声明。

meaning.en: able to continue over a period of time

sentences.en: We need sustainable ways to grow food.
sentences.zh: 我们需要可持续的粮食种植方式。

sentences.en: Cities should promote sustainable transport by investing in reliable bus services and safe cycling infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 城市应投资建设可靠的公交服务和安全的骑行设施，推动可持续交通。

meaning.en: to cause food or drink to pass from the mouth down into the stomach

sentences.en: Please swallow the medicine with water.
sentences.zh: 请用水把药吞下去。

sentences.en: Consumers should not simply swallow advertising claims without examining the evidence behind promises of better health.
sentences.zh: 消费者不应不加审查就轻信广告中改善健康的承诺，而应考察背后的证据。

meaning.en: an area of soft, wet land, often covered with water

sentences.en: Frogs live in the wet swamp.
sentences.zh: 青蛙生活在潮湿的沼泽里。

sentences.en: The heavy rain turned the field into a swamp.
sentences.zh: 大雨把田地变成了一片沼泽。

meaning.en: a large waterbird with a long neck, usually white

sentences.en: A white swan glided silently across the lake.
sentences.zh: 一只白天鹅悄无声息地游过湖面。

sentences.en: Protecting wetland habitats benefits swan populations while also preserving the wider ecosystems on which many other species depend.
sentences.zh: 保护湿地栖息地有益于天鹅种群，同时也能保护许多其他物种赖以生存的更广泛生态系统。

meaning.en: to exchange one thing for another

sentences.en: Can we swap seats for a while?
sentences.zh: 我们能暂时交换一下座位吗？

sentences.en: The two companies agreed to swap technology and share research data.
sentences.zh: 两家公司同意交换技术并共享研究数据。

meaning.en: a large group of flying insects

sentences.en: A swarm of bees left the hive.
sentences.zh: 一群蜜蜂离开了蜂巢。

sentences.en: A swarm of locusts descended on the fields, destroying the crops.
sentences.zh: 一大群蝗虫袭击了田野，毁坏了庄稼。

meaning.en: to move slowly from side to side

sentences.en: Tall trees sway in the strong wind.
sentences.zh: 高大的树木在强风中摇曳。

sentences.en: The branches swayed gently as we ate outdoors.
sentences.zh: 我们在户外吃饭时，树枝轻轻摇曳。

meaning.zh: 影响；左右（某人的决定或看法）
meaning.en: to influence someone's decision or opinion

sentences.en: Emotional advertising can sway consumers' decisions even when competing products offer better value for money.
sentences.zh: 即使竞争产品更划算，情感广告仍可能左右消费者的决定。

meaning.en: to make a serious promise or statement that you will do something or that something is true

sentences.en: I swear I will tell the truth.
sentences.zh: 我发誓我会说实话。

sentences.en: Witnesses must swear to tell the truth before giving evidence in many legal systems.
sentences.zh: 在许多法律体系中，证人作证前必须宣誓如实陈述。

meaning.en: a liquid that passes through your skin when you are hot

sentences.en: Sweat ran down his hot face.
sentences.zh: 汗水顺着他发热的脸流下来。

sentences.en: People who exercise in hot weather lose water through sweat and should drink regularly.
sentences.zh: 在炎热天气里锻炼的人会因出汗而流失水分，应定时饮水。

meaning.en: a warm piece of clothing made of knitted wool or similar material, worn on the upper body

sentences.en: Wear a sweater when it is cold.
sentences.zh: 天冷时要穿毛衣。

sentences.en: Choosing a durable wool sweater rather than several cheap alternatives can reduce clothing waste over time.
sentences.zh: 选择一件耐穿的羊毛衫，而不是多件廉价替代品，长远来看可以减少衣物浪费。

meaning.en: a thick, soft top with long sleeves, often made of cotton, worn for sport or casually

sentences.en: He wears a sweatshirt after sport.
sentences.zh: 运动后他穿一件运动衫。

sentences.en: She pulled on a hooded sweatshirt before going for a run in the cool morning air.
sentences.zh: 清晨凉意中，她套上一件连帽卫衣出去跑步。

meaning.en: a country in northern Europe, with Stockholm as its capital

sentences.en: We travelled through Sweden by train last summer.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，我们乘火车游览了瑞典。

sentences.en: Sweden is frequently discussed in international debates about public welfare, environmental policy, and the funding of education.
sentences.zh: 在有关公共福利、环境政策和教育经费的国际讨论中，瑞典经常被提及。

meaning.zh: 瑞典的；瑞典人的；瑞典语的
meaning.en: relating to Sweden, its people, or its language

sentences.en: Our Swedish neighbour taught us to bake cinnamon buns.
sentences.zh: 我们的瑞典邻居教我们烤肉桂卷。

sentences.en: Swedish cities offer useful examples of how urban planning can support cycling and reduce dependence on cars.
sentences.zh: 瑞典城市提供了有益的实例，展示城市规划如何支持骑行并减少对汽车的依赖。

meaning.en: the language spoken in Sweden

sentences.en: She is learning Swedish so she can study in Stockholm.
sentences.zh: 她正在学瑞典语，以便能去斯德哥尔摩学习。

sentences.en: Swedish is a North Germanic language, and its grammar can be challenging for English speakers.
sentences.zh: 瑞典语是一种北日耳曼语，其语法对英语使用者来说可能颇具挑战。

meaning.en: to clean a floor or other surface using a brush

sentences.en: Please sweep the kitchen floor.
sentences.zh: 请扫一下厨房地板。

sentences.en: Severe storms can sweep across coastal regions, damaging homes and disrupting essential transport services.
sentences.zh: 猛烈的风暴可能席卷沿海地区，损坏房屋并扰乱重要的交通服务。

meaning.en: tasting like sugar or honey

sentences.en: This peach tastes very sweet.
sentences.zh: 这个桃子尝起来很甜。

sentences.en: Reducing children's consumption of sweet drinks may lower their risk of tooth decay and excessive weight gain.
sentences.zh: 减少儿童含糖饮料的摄入，可能降低他们蛀牙和体重过度增长的风险。

meaning.zh: 使变甜；变甜；使更有吸引力
meaning.en: to make something sweeter or become sweeter; to make something more attractive or appealing

sentences.en: I sweeten my porridge with a little honey.
sentences.zh: 我会加一点蜂蜜，让粥甜一些。

sentences.en: Employers may sweeten job offers with flexible working hours to attract skilled candidates in competitive industries.
sentences.zh: 竞争激烈的行业中，雇主可能提供弹性工作时间，让职位更具吸引力，从而吸引技术人才。

meaning.en: someone you love, especially a romantic partner

sentences.en: My sweetheart brought me flowers after a difficult day.
sentences.zh: 辛苦了一天后，我的爱人给我带来了鲜花。

sentences.en: Many older adults maintain strong emotional connections with sweethearts they first met during their school years.
sentences.zh: 许多年长者与学生时代结识的恋人仍保持着深厚的感情联系。

meaning.en: to become larger or rounder, especially because of injury or illness

sentences.en: His ankle began to swell after the fall.
sentences.zh: 摔倒后，他的脚踝开始肿起来。

sentences.en: Seasonal tourism can swell the population of coastal towns, placing additional pressure on local water supplies.
sentences.zh: 季节性旅游会使沿海城镇人口增加，给当地供水带来额外压力。

meaning.en: to change direction suddenly

sentences.en: The car had to swerve left.
sentences.zh: 汽车不得不突然向左转向。

sentences.en: Poorly maintained roads may force drivers to swerve unexpectedly, increasing the risk of collisions with other vehicles.
sentences.zh: 养护不善的道路可能迫使司机突然转向，增加与其他车辆相撞的风险。

meaning.en: Moving quickly or happening after very little delay.

sentences.en: She made a swift movement and caught the falling glass.
sentences.zh: 她动作敏捷，接住了快要掉下去的玻璃杯。

sentences.en: A swift response to disease outbreaks can reduce pressure on hospitals and protect vulnerable communities.
sentences.zh: 迅速应对疾病暴发可以减轻医院压力，并保护脆弱群体。

meaning.en: in a quick and rapid way

sentences.en: The fox ran swiftly across the open field.
sentences.zh: 狐狸迅速地跑过开阔的田野。

sentences.en: The government acted swiftly to contain the economic crisis.
sentences.zh: 政府迅速采取行动以遏制经济危机。

meaning.en: to move through water using your arms and legs

sentences.en: We swim in the pool in summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天我们在泳池里游泳。

sentences.en: Schools should teach children to swim because this essential skill improves both physical fitness and water safety.
sentences.zh: 学校应教孩子游泳，因为这项基本技能既能增强体能，又能提高水上安全性。

meaning.en: a person who swims, especially for sport or recreation

sentences.en: She is a strong swimmer.
sentences.zh: 她是个游泳好手。

sentences.en: The swimmer trained for months before the competition.
sentences.zh: 这名游泳运动员在比赛前训练了几个月。

meaning.en: the activity or sport of moving through water by moving your arms and legs

sentences.en: We go swimming in the indoor pool every Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我们每周六都去室内泳池游泳。

sentences.en: Regular swimming can improve physical fitness while placing relatively little stress on the joints.
sentences.zh: 经常游泳可以增强体质，同时对关节造成的压力相对较小。

meaning.en: a piece of clothing worn for swimming

sentences.en: Pack your swimsuit for the pool.
sentences.zh: 去游泳池要带上你的泳衣。

sentences.en: She bought a new swimsuit before her beach holiday.
sentences.zh: 她去海滩度假前买了一件新泳衣。

meaning.en: to move backward and forward or from side to side

sentences.en: The children swing on the swings in the park.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在公园里荡秋千。

sentences.en: A sharp swing in public opinion can encourage governments to reconsider policies that previously enjoyed widespread support.
sentences.zh: 公众意见的急剧转变可能促使政府重新审视此前获得广泛支持的政策。

meaning.en: to move in a twisting circular way

sentences.en: Leaves swirl in the autumn wind.
sentences.zh: 树叶在秋风中打旋。

sentences.en: Dust can swirl through urban streets during construction, reducing air quality and causing discomfort for nearby residents.
sentences.zh: 施工时，灰尘可能在城市街道中盘旋，降低空气质量，并让附近居民感到不适。

meaning.zh: 瑞士的；瑞士人的；瑞士文化的
meaning.en: Relating to Switzerland, its people, or their culture.

sentences.en: We tasted Swiss cheese while picnicking by the lake.
sentences.zh: 我们在湖边野餐时品尝了瑞士奶酪。

sentences.en: Swiss railways demonstrate how reliable public transport can connect remote mountain communities and support sustainable tourism.
sentences.zh: 瑞士铁路展示了可靠的公共交通如何连接偏远山区社区并支持可持续旅游。

meaning.en: a small device that starts or stops the flow of electricity

sentences.en: Please turn off the light switch.
sentences.zh: 请关掉电灯开关。

meaning.en: to change from one thing to another

sentences.en: Governments can encourage households to switch to renewable energy by offering financial support.
sentences.zh: 政府可以提供经济支持，鼓励家庭改用可再生能源。

meaning.en: a country in central Europe known for the Alps

sentences.en: During the holiday, we traveled through Switzerland by train.
sentences.zh: 假期里，我们乘火车游览了瑞士。

sentences.en: Switzerland demonstrates how reliable rail networks can support tourism while reducing dependence on private cars.
sentences.zh: 瑞士展示了可靠的铁路网络如何在支持旅游业的同时减少对私家车的依赖。

meaning.en: larger than normal because of injury or illness

sentences.en: My ankle was swollen after I fell during practice.
sentences.zh: 训练时摔倒后，我的脚踝肿了起来。

sentences.en: After several days of heavy rain, the swollen river threatened homes built close to its banks.
sentences.zh: 连续数日的大雨过后，水位上涨的河流威胁着沿岸的住宅。

meaning.en: to fly or move down quickly and suddenly, especially to attack

sentences.en: The eagle will swoop on the rabbit.

meaning.en: a weapon with a long metal blade and a handle

sentences.en: The knight holds a long sword.
sentences.zh: 骑士握着一把长剑。

sentences.en: The discovery of a decorated sword provides evidence of advanced metalworking skills in this ancient society.
sentences.zh: 一把装饰精美的剑的发现，为这个古代社会拥有先进金属加工技术提供了证据。

meaning.en: a large fish with a long pointed nose

sentences.en: The swordfish has a long nose.
sentences.zh: 剑鱼有一个长长的吻部。

sentences.en: Swordfish are known for their speed and can be found in warm ocean waters.
sentences.zh: 剑鱼以速度快著称，常见于温暖的海洋水域。

meaning.en: a shape, sign, or object that represents something else

sentences.en: A heart is a symbol of love.
sentences.zh: 心形是爱的象征。

sentences.en: Public parks can become a symbol of a city's commitment to environmental protection and residents' quality of life.
sentences.zh: 公共公园可以成为城市致力于环境保护和提升居民生活质量的象征。

meaning.en: the quality of having two halves that match exactly in shape and size

sentences.en: The garden is designed with perfect symmetry.
sentences.zh: 这座花园设计得完全对称。

sentences.en: Architects often use symmetry to create buildings that appear balanced and visually pleasing to visitors.
sentences.zh: 建筑师常利用对称性，使建筑在参观者眼中显得平衡而美观。

meaning.en: showing understanding and care for someone's difficulties

sentences.en: My manager was sympathetic when I explained my difficulties.
sentences.zh: 我说明困难后，经理表示理解。

sentences.en: Employers who are sympathetic to carers' needs can improve staff wellbeing by offering flexible working arrangements.
sentences.zh: 体谅照护者需求的雇主可以通过提供灵活的工作安排来改善员工福祉。

meaning.en: To understand and care about someone's suffering or difficulties.

sentences.en: I sympathize with you; losing a pet is painful.
sentences.zh: 我很理解你的感受；失去宠物确实令人难过。

sentences.en: Many residents sympathize with workers demanding better conditions, although they find the transport strike inconvenient.
sentences.zh: 许多居民支持工人改善工作条件的诉求，尽管他们觉得交通罢工带来了不便。

meaning.en: the feeling of being sorry for someone who is in a bad situation

sentences.en: We felt sympathy for the lost child.
sentences.zh: 我们对那个迷路的孩子感到同情。

sentences.en: She has little sympathy for people who waste money.
sentences.zh: 她对那些浪费钱的人几乎没有同情心。

meaning.en: a long piece of music written for a full orchestra

sentences.en: The orchestra played a famous symphony.
sentences.zh: 管弦乐队演奏了一首著名的交响曲。

sentences.en: Performing a symphony requires close cooperation among musicians, demonstrating the importance of teamwork in the arts.
sentences.zh: 演奏交响曲需要音乐家之间密切合作，体现了团队协作在艺术中的重要性。

meaning.en: a meeting where experts discuss a particular subject

sentences.en: Leila met several researchers at a symposium yesterday.
sentences.zh: 莱拉昨天在一场专题研讨会上结识了几位研究人员。

sentences.en: The international symposium brought together scientists to discuss practical solutions to urban air pollution.
sentences.zh: 这场国际专题研讨会汇聚了科学家，共同讨论解决城市空气污染的可行办法。

meaning.en: a sign or indication that someone has an illness or that something is wrong

sentences.en: A cough is a symptom of a cold.
sentences.zh: 咳嗽是感冒的一种症状。

sentences.en: High staff turnover can be a symptom of poor management rather than a shortage of skilled workers.
sentences.zh: 员工流动率高可能反映管理不善，而非技术工人短缺。

meaning.zh: 辛迪加；财团；报业/新闻联合组织
meaning.en: a group of people or companies that work together, especially to control a market or share content

sentences.en: A news syndicate shared the story widely.
sentences.zh: 一家新闻联合组织广泛传播了这篇报道。

sentences.en: The investigation revealed that a powerful syndicate controlled most of the local media.
sentences.zh: 调查显示，一个强大的财团控制了当地大部分媒体。

meaning.en: a set of medical signs and symptoms that occur together and characterize a particular condition

sentences.en: The doctor explained the rare syndrome clearly.
sentences.zh: 医生清楚地解释了这种罕见的综合征。

sentences.en: Early recognition of a syndrome can help healthcare professionals provide appropriate support and manage symptoms more effectively.
sentences.zh: 及早识别综合征，有助于医疗人员提供适当支持，并更有效地控制症状。

meaning.en: a word or phrase that means exactly or nearly the same as another word or phrase in the same language

sentences.en: Big is a synonym of large.
sentences.zh: big 是 large 的同义词。

sentences.en: In formal writing, you can use 'commence' as a synonym for 'begin'.
sentences.zh: 在正式写作中，你可以用 commence 作为 begin 的同义词。

meaning.en: A short account of the main points of a work.

sentences.en: I read the synopsis before borrowing the novel.
sentences.zh: 借这本小说之前，我先看了故事梗概。

sentences.en: Students should provide a brief synopsis of their proposed research before discussing the methods they intend to use.
sentences.zh: 学生在讨论拟采用的方法之前，应先简要概述计划开展的研究。

meaning.en: the act of combining parts into a whole

sentences.en: The paper is a synthesis of ideas.
sentences.zh: 这篇论文是各种观点的综合。

sentences.en: A synthesis of findings from several studies provides stronger evidence for the benefits of regular exercise.
sentences.zh: 综合多项研究的结果，能为经常锻炼的益处提供更有力的证据。

meaning.en: a sweet, thick, sticky liquid made from sugar or fruit juice

sentences.en: Pour a little syrup on the pancakes.
sentences.zh: 在煎饼上倒一点糖浆。

sentences.en: Fruit preserved in syrup often contains more added sugar than fresh fruit, which may concern health-conscious consumers.
sentences.zh: 糖浆保存的水果通常比新鲜水果含有更多添加糖，这可能让注重健康的消费者担忧。

meaning.en: an organized way of working or planning something

sentences.en: The school has a new bus system.
sentences.zh: 学校有一套新的公交系统。

sentences.en: An effective education system should support students with different abilities and prepare them for future employment.
sentences.zh: 有效的教育体系应支持能力各异的学生，并帮助他们为未来就业做好准备。

meaning.en: Following an organised plan or method rather than acting randomly.

sentences.en: She took a systematic approach to packing her luggage, so everything was easy to find later.
sentences.zh: 她收拾行李很有条理，之后什么都很容易找到。

sentences.en: A systematic review of existing research can help governments develop more effective public health policies.
sentences.zh: 对现有研究进行系统综述，有助于政府制定更有效的公共卫生政策。

meaning.en: A casual shirt, usually with short sleeves and no collar.

sentences.en: I packed a clean T-shirt for the picnic.
sentences.zh: 我为野餐带了一件干净的T恤衫。

sentences.en: Choosing a durable cotton T-shirt instead of disposable fashion can reduce waste and encourage more responsible consumption.
sentences.zh: 选择耐穿的棉质T恤衫而非一次性时尚服饰，可以减少浪费并促进更负责任的消费。

meaning.zh: 标签；拉环；小突出物（用于拉开或标记）
meaning.en: a small flap, strip, or ring used to open, fasten, or mark something

sentences.en: Pull the tab to open the can.
sentences.zh: 拉一下拉环打开罐头。

sentences.en: He lifted the tab on the folder to see the label.
sentences.zh: 他掀起文件夹上的标签查看标记。

meaning.en: a piece of furniture with a flat top and one or more legs, used for putting things on or for eating, working, etc.

sentences.en: The cups are on the table.
sentences.zh: 杯子在桌子上。

sentences.en: The table compares average household spending on transport in three cities over a ten-year period.
sentences.zh: 该表比较了三个城市十年间的家庭平均交通支出。

meaning.en: a small, solid piece of medicine

sentences.en: She took one tablet after dinner.
sentences.zh: 她晚饭后吃了一片药。

sentences.en: Take one tablet three times a day after meals.
sentences.zh: 每日三次，每次一片，饭后服用。

meaning.en: a flat portable computer with a touchscreen

sentences.en: He watches cooking videos on his tablet.
sentences.zh: 他用平板电脑看烹饪视频。

sentences.en: Providing every student with a tablet may improve access to resources, but teachers still need suitable training.
sentences.zh: 为每名学生配备平板电脑可能有助于获取学习资源，但教师仍需接受适当培训。

meaning.zh: 小报（常指内容通俗、注重耸动新闻的报纸）
meaning.en: a small newspaper with short articles and often sensational content

sentences.en: The tabloid printed a wild story.
sentences.zh: 那份小报刊登了一则耸人听闻的报道。

sentences.en: She avoids tabloids because they often exaggerate celebrity gossip.
sentences.zh: 她避开小报，因为它们常常夸大名人八卦。

meaning.zh: 禁忌；忌讳（社会习俗中禁止谈论或做的事情）
meaning.en: a social custom that forbids doing or talking about something

sentences.en: That topic is still a taboo.
sentences.zh: 那个话题仍然是禁忌。

sentences.en: Public education can challenge the taboo surrounding mental illness and encourage more people to seek support.
sentences.zh: 公众教育可以挑战围绕精神疾病的禁忌，鼓励更多人寻求支持。

meaning.en: understood or implied without being stated

sentences.en: There was a tacit agreement to wait.
sentences.zh: 大家心照不宣地同意等待。

sentences.en: Public silence should not be interpreted as tacit approval of policies that restrict access to essential services.
sentences.zh: 不应把公众的沉默理解为对限制基本服务获取的政策的默许。

meaning.en: a short nail with a flat head, used for fastening papers or fabric to a surface

sentences.en: Use a tack to hang the note on the board.
sentences.zh: 用一枚图钉把便条钉在板上。

sentences.en: When public campaigns fail to change behaviour, policymakers may need to take a different tack.
sentences.zh: 当公共宣传活动无法改变行为时，政策制定者可能需要换一种方法。

meaning.en: to make a determined effort to deal with a problem or task

sentences.en: We must tackle this problem before Friday.
sentences.zh: 我们必须在周五之前处理这个问题。

sentences.en: Governments need to tackle housing shortages by supporting affordable construction and improving access to public transport.
sentences.zh: 政府需要通过支持可负担住房建设和改善公共交通的可及性来应对住房短缺。

meaning.zh: 得体；圆通；机智（指避免冒犯他人的能力）
meaning.en: the ability to deal with people or difficult situations without offending them

sentences.en: She handled the complaint with tact.
sentences.zh: 她得体地处理了那起投诉。

sentences.en: He showed great tact in avoiding any mention of her recent failure.
sentences.zh: 他非常圆通，避而不谈她最近的失败。

meaning.en: Careful not to upset or offend people; showing skill in dealing with sensitive matters.

sentences.en: Her tactful reply saved everyone from an awkward argument.
sentences.zh: 她得体的回答让大家避免了一场尴尬的争论。

sentences.en: Managers who provide tactful feedback can address performance problems while maintaining employees' confidence and motivation.
sentences.zh: 管理者以得体的方式提供反馈，既能解决工作表现问题，也能维持员工的信心和积极性。

meaning.en: a method or plan for achieving something

sentences.en: Waiting quietly was a smart tactic.
sentences.zh: 安静等待是一个聪明的策略。

sentences.en: Offering cheaper public transport is one tactic cities can use to discourage unnecessary car journeys.
sentences.zh: 提供更便宜的公共交通是城市减少不必要驾车出行的一种策略。

meaning.en: Specific methods used to achieve a goal or gain an advantage.

sentences.en: Our coach changed tactics halfway through the football match.
sentences.zh: 足球比赛进行到一半时，我们的教练改变了战术。

sentences.en: Companies increasingly use digital marketing tactics to attract younger consumers and compete in crowded markets.
sentences.zh: 企业越来越多地采用数字营销策略来吸引年轻消费者，并在竞争激烈的市场中争得优势。

meaning.en: the larva of a frog or toad, which lives in water and has a tail

sentences.en: A tadpole swam in the pond.
sentences.zh: 一只蝌蚪在池塘里游动。

sentences.en: As the tadpole grows, it gradually develops legs and loses its tail.
sentences.zh: 随着蝌蚪生长，它逐渐长出腿并失去尾巴。

meaning.en: a small piece of paper, cloth, or plastic attached to something to give information about it

sentences.en: The price tag is still on the shirt.
sentences.zh: 这件衬衫上的价格标签还在。

sentences.en: Researchers tag marine animals to track their movements and identify habitats that require stronger environmental protection.
sentences.zh: 研究人员给海洋动物加上追踪标记，以追踪其活动并确定需要加强环境保护的栖息地。

meaning.en: the long part at the back of an animal

sentences.en: The dog wags its tail.
sentences.zh: 那只狗摇着尾巴。

sentences.en: Some animals use their tails for balance, which helps them move safely through complex forest habitats.
sentences.zh: 一些动物用尾巴保持平衡，这有助于它们在复杂的森林栖息地中安全移动。

meaning.en: a person who makes or repairs clothes

sentences.en: The tailor repaired my old coat.
sentences.zh: 裁缝修补了我的旧外套。

sentences.en: She took her wedding dress to a tailor for adjustments.
sentences.zh: 她把婚纱拿到裁缝那里修改。

meaning.en: to make or adjust something for a particular purpose or person

sentences.en: The program is tailored to meet the needs of beginners.
sentences.zh: 该课程是为满足初学者的需求而量身定制的。

sentences.en: Teachers should tailor their lessons to students' abilities rather than follow a single approach for everyone.
sentences.zh: 教师应根据学生的能力调整课程，而不是对所有人采用同一种方法。

meaning.en: to damage the quality or reputation of something

sentences.en: One lie can taint a good reputation.
sentences.zh: 一句谎言就能玷污好名声。

sentences.en: The scandal tainted the company's image for years.
sentences.zh: 这起丑闻多年来一直败坏着公司的形象。

meaning.en: to carry or move something to another place

sentences.en: Please take your bag with you.
sentences.zh: 请把你的包带走。

sentences.en: Developing reliable public transport networks takes considerable time and requires sustained investment from local authorities.
sentences.zh: 建设可靠的公共交通网络需要相当长的时间，也需要地方政府持续投入资金。

meaning.en: to buy prepared food or drink and eat or drink it somewhere else

sentences.en: Could I have a vegetable sandwich to take away?
sentences.zh: 请给我一个蔬菜三明治打包带走，好吗？

sentences.en: Restaurants should offer reusable containers to customers who buy meals to take away, reducing packaging waste.
sentences.zh: 餐馆应为购买外带餐食的顾客提供可重复使用的容器，以减少包装废弃物。

meaning.en: The moment an aircraft leaves the ground.

sentences.en: Please keep your seat belt fastened during take-off.
sentences.zh: 起飞期间请系好安全带。

sentences.en: Aircraft noise during take-off can significantly affect the quality of life in communities near major airports.
sentences.zh: 飞机起飞时的噪声会显著影响大型机场附近社区的生活质量。

meaning.en: a story people tell for fun

sentences.en: Grandma tells a tale about the sea.
sentences.zh: 祖母讲了一个关于大海的故事。

sentences.en: Traditional tales can preserve cultural values while helping children explore complex emotions through memorable characters.
sentences.zh: 传统故事既能传承文化价值观，也能通过令人难忘的角色帮助儿童探索复杂情感。

meaning.en: a natural ability to do something well

sentences.en: My cousin has a talent for drawing animals.
sentences.zh: 我的表亲画动物很有天赋。

sentences.en: Schools should nurture creative talent alongside academic skills to help students develop a wider range of abilities.
sentences.zh: 学校应在培养学业技能的同时培育创造性才能，帮助学生发展更广泛的能力。

meaning.en: having a natural ability to do something well

sentences.en: The talented girl sings very well.
sentences.zh: 那个有天赋的女孩唱歌很好听。

sentences.en: Schools should provide opportunities for talented students to develop their abilities beyond the standard curriculum.
sentences.zh: 学校应为有才华的学生提供机会，让他们在标准课程之外发展自己的能力。

meaning.en: to say words to another person; to have a conversation

sentences.en: We talk about our weekend.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论我们的周末。

sentences.en: Schools should encourage students to talk openly about stress and seek support when they need it.
sentences.zh: 学校应鼓励学生坦诚谈论压力，并在需要时寻求帮助。

meaning.en: having a greater height than average

sentences.en: My brother is very tall.
sentences.zh: 下午，一棵高大的树为我们的花园遮阴。

meaning.en: to match or agree with something

sentences.en: The figures tally with our records.
sentences.zh: 这些数字与我们的记录吻合。

sentences.en: His account of the accident does not tally with the witness's version.
sentences.zh: 他对事故的描述与目击者的说法不一致。

meaning.en: not dangerous or frightened of people; domesticated

sentences.en: The tame rabbit sat in her hands.
sentences.zh: 那只温顺的兔子坐在她的手里。

sentences.en: Even tame animals require careful handling, especially when young children are learning to interact with them.
sentences.zh: 即使是驯服的动物也需要谨慎对待，尤其是在幼儿学习与它们互动时。

meaning.zh: 擅自改动；篡改（常与 with 连用）
meaning.en: to change or touch something without permission, often in a way that causes damage

sentences.en: Do not tamper with the lock.
sentences.zh: 不要擅自改动锁。

sentences.en: Someone had tampered with the evidence before the police arrived.
sentences.zh: 警察到达之前，有人已经篡改了证据。

meaning.en: a brown color of the skin caused by exposure to the sun

sentences.en: She got a tan at the beach.
sentences.zh: 她在海滩上晒黑了。

sentences.en: Although a tan is sometimes considered attractive, prolonged exposure to sunlight increases the risk of skin damage.
sentences.zh: 虽然晒成棕褐色有时被认为很有吸引力，但长时间日晒会增加皮肤受损的风险。

meaning.zh: 可触摸的；有形的；确实的
meaning.en: real enough to touch or see; clear and definite

sentences.en: We need tangible proof of this.

meaning.en: a confused mass of things twisted together

sentences.en: The wires are in a tangle.
sentences.zh: 电线缠结在一起。

sentences.en: Small businesses often face a tangle of regulations that makes expansion costly and time-consuming.
sentences.zh: 小企业常面临错综复杂的法规，使业务扩张既费钱又费时。

meaning.en: a large container for holding water, especially one used for storing water or keeping fish

sentences.en: Fish swim in the glass tank.
sentences.zh: 鱼在玻璃鱼缸里游来游去。

sentences.en: Installing a rainwater tank allows households to water gardens without relying entirely on treated drinking water.
sentences.zh: 安装雨水储水箱能让家庭浇灌花园时不必完全依赖经过处理的饮用水。

meaning.zh: 油轮；罐车；运输液体的船只或车辆
meaning.en: A ship or vehicle designed to carry large quantities of liquid, such as oil

sentences.en: A huge tanker sailed into the port.
sentences.zh: 一艘巨大的油轮驶入港口。

sentences.en: An accident involving an oil tanker can cause lasting damage to coastal ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 涉及油轮的事故可能对沿海生态系统造成持久损害。

meaning.zh: 逗弄；引诱（可望而不可即）
meaning.en: to tease or excite someone by showing them something desirable that they cannot have

sentences.en: Do not tantalize the hungry dog with a bone you will not give it.
sentences.zh: 不要用一根不会给它的骨头逗弄那只饥饿的狗。

sentences.en: Early discoveries tantalize researchers with the possibility of finding affordable treatments for currently incurable diseases.
sentences.zh: 早期发现让研究人员对找到价格可负担的疗法、治疗目前尚无法治愈的疾病充满期待。

meaning.zh: 发脾气；（尤指儿童的）突然哭闹
meaning.en: a sudden outburst of anger or frustration, especially by a young child

sentences.en: The toddler threw a tantrum.
sentences.zh: 那个幼儿突然大发脾气。

sentences.en: He had a tantrum when his mother turned off the TV.
sentences.zh: 他妈妈关掉电视时，他大闹了一场。

meaning.en: to hit gently and quickly

sentences.en: Please tap on the door twice.
sentences.zh: 请轻敲两下门。

meaning.en: to make use of a resource or source of knowledge

sentences.en: Universities can tap local expertise to develop practical solutions to environmental problems affecting nearby communities.
sentences.zh: 大学可以利用当地的专业知识，为影响周边社区的环境问题制定切实可行的解决方案。

meaning.en: a long thin strip of sticky plastic used for sticking things, or a magnetic strip used for recording sound or data

sentences.en: Use tape to close the box.
sentences.zh: 用胶带把箱子封上。

sentences.en: Older interviews stored on magnetic tape should be digitised to preserve valuable records for future historical research.
sentences.zh: 保存在磁带上的早期访谈应进行数字化处理，为未来的历史研究保存珍贵记录。

meaning.en: A device that records and plays sound using magnetic tape.

sentences.en: My grandfather still uses a tape-recorder to record songs.
sentences.zh: 我祖父仍用磁带录音机录制歌曲。

sentences.en: Before digital devices became widespread, researchers often used a tape-recorder to preserve interviews for later analysis.
sentences.zh: 在数字设备普及之前，研究人员常用磁带录音机保存访谈内容，以供后续分析。

meaning.en: sound recorded on magnetic tape

sentences.en: We found a tape-recording of our grandfather singing.
sentences.zh: 我们找到了一段祖父唱歌的磁带录音。

sentences.en: A tape-recording of a traditional song can help researchers understand how local musical styles have changed.
sentences.zh: 一段传统歌曲的磁带录音能帮助研究人员了解当地音乐风格的变化。

meaning.zh: 逐渐变细；使一端逐渐变细
meaning.en: to become gradually thinner toward one end

sentences.en: The candle will taper at the top.
sentences.zh: 蜡烛顶部会逐渐变细。

sentences.en: The trousers taper slightly toward the ankle.
sentences.zh: 这条裤子向脚踝处略微收窄。

meaning.en: a thick, sticky, black substance made from coal or wood, used especially for making roads

sentences.en: Workers spread black tar on the road.
sentences.zh: 工人们在路上铺撒黑色柏油。

sentences.en: The old roof was covered with tar to keep the rain out.
sentences.zh: 旧屋顶上涂了焦油以防雨水渗入。

meaning.en: the weight of packaging or a container without its contents

sentences.en: Tare the scale before adding flour to the bowl.
sentences.zh: 往碗里加面粉前，先把秤去皮归零。

sentences.en: Accurate tare measurements allow food producers to calculate product weight without including the packaging.
sentences.zh: 准确测量皮重，能让食品生产商计算不含包装的产品重量。

meaning.en: a goal or result that you aim to achieve; an object aimed at in shooting

sentences.en: The arrow hit the target.
sentences.zh: 箭射中了靶子。

sentences.en: Governments should set realistic targets for reducing emissions and regularly assess progress towards achieving them.
sentences.zh: 政府应制定切实可行的减排目标，并定期评估实现目标的进展。

meaning.en: a tax on goods that enter a country

sentences.en: The new tariff raised food prices.
sentences.zh: 新关税使食品价格上涨。

sentences.en: Although tariffs may protect domestic manufacturers, they can also raise consumer prices and provoke trade disputes.
sentences.zh: 关税虽然可能保护国内制造商，但也可能推高消费价格并引发贸易争端。

meaning.zh: 使失去光泽；玷污，败坏（名声等）
meaning.en: to make metal dull by oxidation; to damage or lessen the reputation of something

sentences.en: Air can tarnish silver.
sentences.zh: 空气会使银失去光泽。

sentences.en: The scandal tarnished the company's reputation.
sentences.zh: 这起丑闻败坏了公司的声誉。

meaning.en: a piece of work that must be done

sentences.en: Cleaning the board is my task.
sentences.zh: 擦黑板是我的任务。

sentences.en: Dividing a complex task into smaller stages can help students manage their time more effectively.
sentences.zh: 把复杂任务分成较小的阶段，可以帮助学生更有效地管理时间。

meaning.en: to try food or drink to see what its flavour is like

sentences.en: Taste the soup before you eat.
sentences.zh: 吃之前先尝一下这汤。

sentences.en: Children may develop a taste for healthier foods when schools offer varied and appealing meals.
sentences.zh: 学校提供多样且诱人的餐食，可能会让孩子逐渐喜欢上更健康的食物。

meaning.en: having little or no flavour

sentences.en: The soup was tasteless because there was no salt in it.
sentences.zh: 这汤没有味道，因为里面没放盐。

sentences.en: The vegetables looked fresh, but they were completely tasteless.
sentences.zh: 这些蔬菜看起来很新鲜，但完全没有味道。

meaning.en: having a pleasant taste; delicious

sentences.en: This soup is very tasty.
sentences.zh: 这汤很好喝。

sentences.en: School canteens can encourage healthier eating by offering tasty meals made with fresh vegetables and whole grains.
sentences.zh: 学校食堂可以提供用新鲜蔬菜和全谷物制作的美味餐食，鼓励更健康的饮食。

meaning.en: a design that is marked permanently on a person’s skin

sentences.en: He has a small tattoo on his arm.
sentences.zh: 他的手臂上有一个小纹身。

sentences.en: The tattoo on her back took three hours to complete.
sentences.zh: 她背上的纹身花了三个小时才完成。

meaning.en: to laugh at or insult someone in a cruel way, often to provoke them

sentences.en: Do not taunt the younger children.
sentences.zh: 不要嘲弄年幼的孩子。

sentences.en: The crowd taunted the player after he missed the penalty.
sentences.zh: 那名球员罚失点球后，人群对他进行了讥讽。

meaning.en: pulled or stretched tight

sentences.en: The rope was taut and strong.
sentences.zh: 绳子绷得紧紧的，很结实。

sentences.en: Her expression was taut with worry as she waited for the results.
sentences.zh: 等待结果时，她的神情因担忧而紧绷着。

meaning.en: money that you must pay to the government

sentences.en: People pay tax to the city.
sentences.zh: 人们向城市缴税。

sentences.en: Governments can use tax revenue to improve public transport and make healthcare more accessible.
sentences.zh: 政府可以利用税收改善公共交通，让医疗服务惠及更多人。

meaning.en: The system or process of collecting money through taxes.

sentences.en: Taxation helps pay for our local schools and roads.
sentences.zh: 税收为我们当地的学校和道路提供资金。

sentences.en: Progressive taxation can reduce income inequality by requiring wealthier citizens to contribute a larger proportion of their earnings.
sentences.zh: 累进税制要求较富裕的公民缴纳更高比例的收入，有助于缩小收入差距。

meaning.en: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere

sentences.en: We took a taxi home with our heavy luggage.
sentences.zh: 我们带着沉重的行李，打车回了家。

sentences.en: Improving public transport could reduce dependence on taxis and private cars in crowded city centres.
sentences.zh: 改善公共交通可以减少人们在拥挤的市中心对出租车和私家车的依赖。

meaning.en: A person or organization that pays taxes.

sentences.en: As a taxpayer, I want cleaner streets and safer parks.
sentences.zh: 作为纳税人，我希望街道更干净，公园更安全。

sentences.en: Public infrastructure projects should deliver lasting benefits to the taxpayers who finance them.
sentences.zh: 公共基础设施项目应为出资的纳税人带来持久的益处。

meaning.en: a hot drink made by pouring boiling water onto tea leaves

sentences.en: Grandma drinks tea in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 奶奶在下午喝茶。

sentences.en: In many cultures, sharing tea provides an opportunity for conversation and strengthens relationships between generations.
sentences.zh: 在许多文化中，一起喝茶为交谈提供了机会，也增进了代际关系。

meaning.en: to give lessons to students or help someone learn a skill or subject

sentences.en: My aunt taught me how to sew a shirt.
sentences.zh: 姑姑教会了我如何缝补衬衫。

sentences.en: Schools should teach children how to evaluate online information rather than simply memorise facts.
sentences.zh: 学校应教孩子如何评估网上的信息，而非只是死记事实。

meaning.en: a person whose job is to teach students in a school or other place of learning

sentences.en: The teacher writes on the board.
sentences.zh: 老师在黑板上写字。

sentences.en: A well-trained teacher can adapt classroom activities to support students with different learning needs and abilities.
sentences.zh: 训练有素的教师能够调整课堂活动，以帮助学习需求和能力各不相同的学生。

meaning.en: The work of helping people learn knowledge or skills.

sentences.en: Her love of teaching began at a small village school.
sentences.zh: 她对教学的热爱始于一所小乡村学校。

sentences.en: Effective teaching should combine clear explanations with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge independently.
sentences.zh: 有效的教学应将清晰的讲解与实践活动结合起来，鼓励学生独立运用知识。

meaning.en: A small cup with a handle, used for drinking tea.

sentences.en: She placed a delicate teacup beside the biscuit plate.
sentences.zh: 她把一只精致的茶杯放在饼干盘旁。

sentences.en: A museum display of decorated teacups can reveal how domestic tastes and manufacturing techniques changed over time.
sentences.zh: 博物馆展出的装饰茶杯可以揭示家居审美和制造技术如何随时间变化。

meaning.en: a group of people who play a game or work together

sentences.en: Our team wins the football game.
sentences.zh: 我们队赢得了这场足球比赛。

sentences.en: Working in a team helps students develop communication skills that are essential for future employment.
sentences.zh: 团队合作有助于学生培养未来就业所必需的沟通能力。

meaning.en: a member of the same team as you

sentences.en: My teammate passed the ball to me.
sentences.zh: 我的队友把球传给了我。

sentences.en: She is a reliable teammate who always supports the others.
sentences.zh: 她是一个可靠的队友，总是支持其他人。

meaning.en: People working together effectively to achieve a shared goal

sentences.en: Good teamwork helped us finish painting before lunch.
sentences.zh: 良好的团队合作让我们在午饭前刷完了漆。

sentences.en: Group projects can develop teamwork skills that students will need in their future careers.
sentences.zh: 小组项目可以培养学生未来工作所需的团队合作能力。

meaning.en: a container with a handle and a spout, used for making and serving tea

sentences.en: She poured the tea from the teapot into our cups.
sentences.zh: 她把茶从茶壶里倒进我们的杯子。

sentences.en: The little teapot has a cracked lid, so we need to replace it.
sentences.zh: 这个小茶壶的盖子裂了，所以我们需要换一个。

meaning.en: a drop of liquid that comes from your eye when you cry

sentences.en: A tear rolled down her cheek.
sentences.zh: 一滴眼泪顺着她的脸颊滑落。

sentences.en: He wiped away a tear before standing up to speak.
sentences.zh: 他站起来发言前擦掉了一滴眼泪。

meaning.en: to pull paper or cloth so that it rips

sentences.en: Be careful not to tear the paper bag.
sentences.zh: 小心别把纸袋撕破了。

sentences.en: Thin plastic bags tear easily, making them less suitable for repeated use than durable cloth alternatives.
sentences.zh: 薄塑料袋容易撕裂，因此不如耐用的布袋适合反复使用。

meaning.zh: 哭泣的；含泪的；令人伤感的
meaning.en: crying or about to cry; showing or causing sadness

sentences.en: The tearful child held his mother.
sentences.zh: 那个含泪的孩子紧紧抱着他的母亲。

sentences.en: She gave a tearful farewell to her friends before moving abroad.
sentences.zh: 出国前，她含泪与朋友们告别。

meaning.en: to laugh at or make fun of someone in a playful or unkind way

sentences.en: Do not tease your little brother.
sentences.zh: 不要取笑你的弟弟。

sentences.en: Schools should teach children that teasing classmates about their appearance can seriously damage their confidence.
sentences.zh: 学校应教导孩子，取笑同学的外貌可能严重损害他们的自信心。

meaning.en: relating to the practical use of machines or science in industry, medicine, etc.

sentences.en: The job needs technical skill with computers.
sentences.zh: 这份工作需要计算机方面的技术技能。

sentences.en: Schools should teach technical skills alongside academic subjects to prepare students for a changing workplace.
sentences.zh: 学校应在教授文化课程的同时传授技术技能，帮助学生适应不断变化的职场。

meaning.en: someone whose job involves skilled work with machines or technology

sentences.en: A technician fixed the broken computer quickly.
sentences.zh: 一位技术员很快修好了那台坏掉的电脑。

sentences.en: Laboratory technicians play an essential role in medical research by preparing samples and maintaining specialist equipment.
sentences.zh: 实验室技术员通过准备样本和维护专业设备，在医学研究中发挥重要作用。

meaning.en: a method of doing something

sentences.en: This painting technique is new to me.
sentences.zh: 这种绘画技巧对我来说很陌生。

sentences.en: Teachers can use a range of assessment techniques to identify learning difficulties before students fall behind.
sentences.zh: 教师可以运用多种评估方法，在学生落后之前发现他们的学习困难。

meaning.en: relating to technology and its practical development

sentences.en: My grandfather enjoys learning about the latest technological advances.
sentences.zh: 我祖父喜欢了解最新的科技进展。

sentences.en: Technological innovation can improve agricultural productivity while reducing the amount of water required for irrigation.
sentences.zh: 技术创新能够提高农业生产力，同时减少灌溉所需的水量。

meaning.en: scientific knowledge used in practical ways, especially in industry

sentences.en: New technology makes phones smaller.
sentences.zh: 新技术使手机变得更小。

sentences.en: Investment in clean technology can reduce industrial pollution while creating skilled jobs in emerging sectors.
sentences.zh: 投资清洁技术可以减少工业污染，同时在新兴领域创造技术岗位。

meaning.en: too long, slow, and boring

sentences.en: The lecture was tedious and far too long.
sentences.zh: 那场讲座单调乏味，而且太长了。

sentences.en: Automation can free employees from tedious tasks, allowing them to focus on more creative and rewarding work.
sentences.zh: 自动化可以让员工摆脱单调的任务，专注于更有创意和成就感的工作。

meaning.en: to be full of things, especially living things or people

sentences.en: The pond was teeming with tiny fish this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，池塘里满是小鱼。

sentences.en: Healthy coral reefs teem with marine life, making their protection essential for maintaining ocean biodiversity.
sentences.zh: 健康的珊瑚礁生活着大量海洋生物，因此保护珊瑚礁对维持海洋生物多样性至关重要。

meaning.en: a person between 13 and 19 years old

sentences.en: My cousin is a teen.
sentences.zh: 我的表弟是个青少年。

sentences.en: Many teens spend hours on social media every day.
sentences.zh: 许多青少年每天花数小时在社交媒体上。

meaning.en: a person aged between 13 and 19

sentences.en: The teenager helps at the shop.
sentences.zh: 这个十几岁的青少年在商店帮忙。

sentences.en: Schools should provide spaces where teenagers can discuss their concerns and receive support from trained staff.
sentences.zh: 学校应提供场所，让青少年能够讨论自己的困扰，并获得受过培训的工作人员的支持。

meaning.en: Communication over a distance using electronic signals.

sentences.en: Telecommunication keeps our family connected despite the ocean between us.
sentences.zh: 虽然我们一家人远隔重洋，远程通信仍让我们保持联系。

sentences.en: Investment in telecommunication infrastructure can improve rural access to education, healthcare, and employment opportunities.
sentences.zh: 投资电信基础设施可以改善农村地区获取教育、医疗和就业机会的条件。

meaning.en: A system or machine sending document copies over telephone lines.

sentences.en: The office still has a telefax beside the printer.
sentences.zh: 办公室的打印机旁边还放着一台传真机。

sentences.en: Before email became widespread, companies relied on telefax to exchange documents quickly across national borders.
sentences.zh: 在电子邮件普及之前，公司依靠传真来快速跨国交换文件。

meaning.en: a message sent by telegraph and delivered in written form

sentences.en: She sent a telegram to her family to tell them the good news.
sentences.zh: 她给家人发了一封电报，告诉他们这个好消息。

sentences.en: Before telephone services became widely available, sending a telegram was an important way to communicate urgent news.
sentences.zh: 在电话服务广泛普及之前，发电报是传递紧急消息的重要方式。

meaning.en: to send (a message) by telegraph

sentences.en: He telegrammed the news to his office immediately.
sentences.zh: 他立即把消息用电报发给了办公室。

meaning.en: A device or system that sends messages electrically along wires.

sentences.en: The museum guide demonstrated how the old telegraph worked.
sentences.zh: 博物馆讲解员演示了这台老式电报机的工作原理。

sentences.en: The telegraph transformed international communication by allowing information to travel much faster than physical mail.
sentences.zh: 电报使信息传递远快于实物邮件，从而改变了国际通信。

meaning.en: a device or system used to talk to someone who is far away

sentences.en: The telephone rings in the hall.
sentences.zh: 门厅里的电话响了。

sentences.en: Telephone consultations can improve access to healthcare for rural residents who live far from medical centres.
sentences.zh: 电话问诊可以让远离医疗中心的农村居民更方便地获得医疗服务。

meaning.en: a device for making far-away things look bigger

sentences.en: We used a telescope to see stars.
sentences.zh: 我们用望远镜看星星。

sentences.en: Space telescopes allow scientists to study distant galaxies without interference from the Earth's atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 太空望远镜让科学家能够不受地球大气干扰地研究遥远的星系。

meaning.en: a device with a screen that receives and shows broadcast programs, or the programs broadcast in this way

sentences.en: We watch television after dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后我们看电视。

sentences.en: Educational television can introduce children to scientific ideas that are difficult to demonstrate in classrooms.
sentences.zh: 教育类电视节目可以让儿童接触难以在课堂上演示的科学概念。

meaning.en: to say something to someone

sentences.en: Please tell me a short story.
sentences.zh: 请给我讲一个短故事。

sentences.en: Schools should tell parents how personal information about their children is collected and stored.
sentences.zh: 学校应告知家长，孩子的个人信息是如何被收集和保存的。

meaning.en: to recognize or distinguish something

sentences.en: It's hard to tell the twins apart.
sentences.zh: 很难分辨这对双胞胎。

sentences.en: You can tell from her accent that she is from the south.
sentences.zh: 从她的口音可以判断她来自南方。

meaning.en: a bank clerk who gives and receives money

sentences.en: The bank teller counted the money.
sentences.zh: 银行柜员清点了现金。

sentences.en: Although online banking is convenient, bank tellers remain important for customers who need personal assistance.
sentences.zh: 虽然网上银行很方便，但对需要人工协助的客户而言，银行柜员仍然很重要。

meaning.en: a tendency to become angry easily

sentences.en: He has a short temper when he is tired.
sentences.zh: 抽屉又卡住了，他大发脾气。

meaning.en: a person's or animal's natural character, especially as it affects their behavior

sentences.en: She has a calm and gentle temperament.
sentences.zh: 她性情平静温和。

sentences.en: A calm temperament helps healthcare professionals communicate effectively with patients during stressful situations in busy hospitals.
sentences.zh: 在繁忙医院的紧张情境下，沉着的性情有助于医护人员与患者有效沟通。

meaning.en: having a climate that is never very hot or very cold

sentences.en: The island has a temperate climate.
sentences.zh: 这个岛屿气候温和。

sentences.en: Temperate regions may experience significant changes in rainfall patterns as global temperatures continue to rise.
sentences.zh: 随着全球气温持续上升，温带地区的降雨模式可能发生显著变化。

meaning.en: how hot or cold something is, especially the air

sentences.en: The temperature is high at noon.
sentences.zh: 中午气温很高。

sentences.en: Rising ocean temperatures can damage coral reefs and threaten the survival of many marine species.
sentences.zh: 海洋温度上升会破坏珊瑚礁，并威胁许多海洋物种的生存。

meaning.zh: 经回火的；经过处理的（使更坚硬或更强韧）
meaning.en: made harder or stronger by a special treatment, especially metal

sentences.en: The tempered steel is hard and very strong.
sentences.zh: 经过回火处理的钢坚硬且非常强韧。

sentences.en: Tempered glass is used in car windows because it breaks into small, safer pieces.
sentences.zh: 钢化玻璃用于汽车车窗，因为它破碎时会变成更安全的小碎片。

meaning.zh: （用于构成复合形容词）性情……的
meaning.en: having a particular type of temper or mood, used in compounds

sentences.en: She is a good-tempered teacher who rarely gets angry.
sentences.zh: 她是一位脾气很好的老师，很少生气。

sentences.en: Even-tempered people tend to handle stress better.
sentences.zh: 性情平和的人往往能更好地应对压力。

meaning.en: a pattern or model used as a guide for making something

sentences.en: Use this template for the letter.
sentences.zh: 用这个模板来写这封信。

sentences.en: The software provides a template that you can customize for your own report.
sentences.zh: 该软件提供了一个模板，你可以根据自己的报告进行修改。

meaning.en: a building used for religious worship

sentences.en: We visit an old temple on the hill.
sentences.zh: 我们参观了山上的一座古庙。

sentences.en: Restoring an ancient temple can preserve local heritage while attracting visitors interested in history and architecture.
sentences.zh: 修复古庙既可以保护当地遗产，也能吸引对历史和建筑感兴趣的游客。

meaning.en: The speed at which music is played.

sentences.en: The drummer increased the tempo, and everyone danced faster.
sentences.zh: 鼓手加快了节奏，大家也跳得更快了。

sentences.en: The tempo of urban life has accelerated as digital services make daily tasks increasingly immediate.
sentences.zh: 随着数字服务让日常事务的处理越来越即时，城市生活节奏也加快了。

meaning.en: relating to time

sentences.en: We arranged the family photos in temporal order.
sentences.zh: 我们把家庭照片按时间顺序排列。

sentences.en: Understanding temporal patterns in electricity demand can help cities manage their energy supplies more efficiently.
sentences.zh: 了解用电需求随时间变化的规律，有助于城市更高效地管理能源供应。

meaning.en: relating to worldly rather than religious life

sentences.en: The king held temporal power over the land.
sentences.zh: 国王对这片土地拥有世俗权力。

meaning.en: lasting for a short time

sentences.en: This is a temporary classroom.
sentences.zh: 这是一间临时教室。

sentences.en: Temporary accommodation provides essential shelter while families wait for suitable permanent housing to become available.
sentences.zh: 在家庭等待合适的永久住房期间，临时住处提供了必要的栖身之所。

meaning.en: to make someone want to have or do something, especially something unwise

sentences.en: The cakes tempt me every afternoon.
sentences.zh: 每天下午那些蛋糕都诱惑着我。

sentences.en: Heavy discounts may tempt consumers to purchase products they neither need nor originally intended to buy.
sentences.zh: 大幅折扣可能诱使消费者购买既不需要、也原本无意购买的产品。

meaning.en: A strong desire to do or have something, especially something you should avoid; something that causes this desire.

sentences.en: I resisted the temptation to eat another piece of cake.
sentences.zh: 我忍住了再吃一块蛋糕的诱惑。

sentences.en: Students may face the temptation to copy online material rather than develop their own ideas.
sentences.zh: 学生可能会受到诱惑，抄袭网上的材料，而不是形成自己的观点。

meaning.en: the number 10

sentences.en: There are ten students in the classroom.
sentences.zh: 教室里有十名学生。

sentences.en: She counted from one to ten before opening her eyes.
sentences.zh: 她数到十才睁开眼睛。

meaning.en: Able to be defended or maintained against criticism.

sentences.en: His excuse was no longer tenable after we checked.
sentences.zh: 我们核实后，他的借口就再也站不住脚了。

sentences.en: The assumption that economic growth always improves public wellbeing is no longer tenable in every context.
sentences.zh: 经济增长总能改善公众福祉这一假设，已不能在所有情境下成立。

meaning.en: determined to continue despite difficulties

sentences.en: The tenacious runner kept going despite the steep hill.
sentences.zh: 尽管山坡陡峭，那位意志顽强的跑者仍继续前进。

sentences.en: Tenacious researchers often overcome repeated setbacks before producing discoveries that significantly improve public health.
sentences.zh: 坚韧不拔的研究人员往往要克服重重挫折，才能取得显著改善公共健康的发现。

meaning.en: The legal right or arrangement to occupy rented property.

sentences.en: Our tenancy ends next month, so we are packing.
sentences.zh: 我们的租期下个月结束，所以我们正在收拾行李。

sentences.en: Clear tenancy agreements can protect both landlords and tenants by defining their respective rights and responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 清晰的租赁协议可以明确双方各自的权利和责任，从而保护房东与租客。

meaning.en: someone who pays rent to use property or land

sentences.en: The new tenant brought plants for the balcony.
sentences.zh: 新房客带来了几盆植物，准备放在阳台上。

sentences.en: Clear rental agreements protect both the tenant and the landlord by defining their responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 明确的租赁协议通过界定双方责任，保障房客和房东的权益。

meaning.en: to be likely to do something or to happen in a particular way

sentences.en: Cats tend to sleep in the sun.
sentences.zh: 猫往往会睡在阳光下。

sentences.en: People tend to use public transport more frequently when services are reliable, affordable, and easy to access.
sentences.zh: 当公共交通可靠、价格合理且乘坐方便时，人们往往会更频繁地使用它。

meaning.en: a likelihood to behave in a particular way or for something to happen

sentences.en: He has a tendency to talk too fast.
sentences.zh: 他有说话太快的倾向。

sentences.en: There is a growing tendency for people to work from home.
sentences.zh: 人们在家工作的趋势日益明显。

meaning.en: (of food) easy to cut or chew

sentences.en: The meat was tender and easy to cut.
sentences.zh: 这肉很嫩，容易切开。
